BiblicalUsage: To swell, to be puffed up — the proud soul that is not upright, set against the just who shall live by faith, and the people presuming to go up the hill after God had told them not to. Swelling is the picture of pride that will not stay in its place.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe pride is a swelling that always bursts: the just live by faith, not by being lifted up.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
